_comment: gdd-npc-personality.md §9.3 compositional-flavor fragment banks. Keyed by axis name + end (low/high). The mock concatenates fragments for axes that survive the §9.1 deviation filter, plus the motivation phrase, to build a deterministic (no-LLM) personality_summary and speech_notes. Adequate, not creative.

epistemic_curiosity.low: clings to received wisdom and bristles at unfamiliar ideas
epistemic_curiosity.high: is hungry to learn and probes at anything new

societal_orthodoxy.low: has little patience for rank, custom, or protocol
societal_orthodoxy.high: venerates precedent, hierarchy, and the proper form of things

affective_compassion.low: is unmoved by others' suffering and treats people as means
affective_compassion.high: feels others' pain keenly and shields the weak

stress_reactivity.low: stays calm and deliberate even under direct threat
stress_reactivity.high: flares up sharply and acts on impulse when pressed

self_interest.low: weighs every exchange for personal advantage
self_interest.high: keeps their word and cannot be bought

in_group_loyalty.low: treats every bond as a transaction and owes no one
in_group_loyalty.high: is fiercely devoted to their own and will not betray them

mysticism.low: is skeptical of omens and speaks in worldly, concrete terms
mysticism.high: reads divine meaning into events and reveres the sacred

expressiveness.low: says little and lets silences stand

civility.low: is coarse and blunt, careless of etiquette
civility.high: is unfailingly formal and elaborately courteous

jocularity.high: is quick to joke, tease, and deflect with levity

amorousness.low: is reserved and modest, uneasy with flirtation
amorousness.high: is forward and shameless, at ease with innuendo

epicureanism.low: spurns luxury and keeps to plain tastes
epicureanism.high: is devoted to pleasure, fine food, and indulgence

motivation_phrases.wealth: Above all they want to grow richer.
motivation_phrases.power: Above all they want authority and the upper hand.
motivation_phrases.knowledge: Above all they want to learn what others do not know.
motivation_phrases.security: Above all they want to keep themselves and theirs safe.
motivation_phrases.revenge: Above all they want to settle an old score.
motivation_phrases.faith: Above all they want to serve their god.
motivation_phrases.legacy: Above all they want to build something that outlasts them.
motivation_phrases.freedom: Above all they want to be free of obligation.
motivation_phrases.pleasure: Above all they want to enjoy what life offers.
motivation_phrases.duty: Above all they want to fulfill their role.
motivation_phrases.survival: Above all they want to get through the day alive.
motivation_phrases.redemption: Above all they want to atone for an old wrong.

expressiveness.low: Keep replies to one or two short sentences; let pauses carry weight.
expressiveness.high: Speak expansively, with flourish and grand gesture.

civility.low: Be blunt and coarse; ignore etiquette.
civility.high: Use formal address and elaborate courtesy throughout.

jocularity.low: Stay humorless and grave; no jokes.
jocularity.high: Lace speech with jokes, teasing, and levity.

amorousness.low: Stay reserved and modest; avoid flirtation.
amorousness.high: Be flirtatious and forward, comfortable with innuendo.

epicureanism.low: Speak plainly of plain things; disdain excess.
epicureanism.high: Dwell on pleasures, luxuries, and fine living.

mysticism.low: Speak in worldly, concrete terms; wave off the divine.
mysticism.high: Invoke omens and the sacred; read meaning into events.
